content.short: AdaLite is a lightweight, open-source web wallet for Cardano with support for Ledger, Trezor, and BitBox02 hardware wallets.
content.description: AdaLite is a browser-based Cardano wallet built by Vacuumlabs for users who want fast access to ADA without downloading the full blockchain. The wallet works as a client-side interface for sending, receiving, and staking ADA, while also supporting hardware wallets such as Ledger, Trezor, and BitBox02 for stronger key protection. Its open-source approach is designed to keep control in the hands of the user while making everyday interaction with the Cardano network simple and accessible.
